therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: EGFR inhibition combined with fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: elderly frail patients with metastatic colorectal cancer

results.dose_information: Cetuximab 500 mg/m2 every 14 days IV; 5-fluorouracil 400 mg/m2 day 1 + 2400 mg/m2 days 1-3 every 2 weeks IV; leucovorin 200 mg/m2 racemic or 100 mg/m2 l-leucovorin day 1 every 2 weeks IV
